required.name: title
required.label: Page title
required.why: Tells the agent what this set of answers is about before it decides to read all of them.

required.name: question-answer
required.label: Question and answer pairs
required.why: The pairing is the whole content — an agent that cannot tell which answer belongs to which question will attach the wrong one.

recommended.name: updated
recommended.label: Last updated
recommended.why: FAQ answers go stale silently, and the date is the only signal the agent has that one has.

recommended.name: description
recommended.label: Description
recommended.why: Says who these answers are for, so the agent does not quote the reseller FAQ to a retail customer.
